leaves.name: y3FullThreeRepZ30
leaves.doc: y3-route-a, the manuscript's own conclusion (diophantine_zq.tex L473-477; one object: the integral model X35/G5 of Y3 with its universal family): the moduli problem of abelian surfaces with an action of the maximal order O of B = (2,-3|Q) and full O-linear level-3 structure (QMAbSchemeP: at every geometric point eta : O/3O = A_s[3], i.e. a section of Isom_O(O/3O, A[3])) is represented on locally noetherian Z[1/30]-schemes by a proper smooth curve over Z[1/30] with a universal QMAbSchemeP; its generic fibre is Y3 (proved: Y3RouteA.y3RepresentableQ_of_z30 gives Y3Audit.Y3RepresentableQ). Manuscript derivation: Buzzard, Duke Math. J. 87 (1997) Thm 2.1 and Cor. 2.3 at V1(5) over Z[1/30] (L443-446); full five-marking (L447-449); the finite etale sheaf Isom_O(O/3O, A[3]), nonempty on geometric fibres since the Tate lattice is free of rank one over O_3 (L449-462); free action of G5 = (O/5O)^x by torsion-freeness of 1 + 3M4(Z3) (L465-472); quotient X35/G5 and descent of the universal abelian scheme with polarization, O-action and three-marking (L472-477). Weaker than the manuscript: proper for projective, locally noetherian universe-0 bases, no polarization (equivalent through the canonical principal polarization, relative Lemma P: ON THE SPOT, not proved in the tree). Implies Y3Fix.Y3FineModuliAbP (Y3RouteA.y3FineModuliAbP_of_z30).
leaves.flag: ELLIOT: the manuscript's own claim (diophantine_zq.tex L473-477), derived there from Buzzard 1997 Thm 2.1 / Cor. 2.3 at V1(5) plus the Isom sheaf, the free G5 = (O/5O)^x quotient and descent (L443-477); not a print at level 3 (Buzzard excludes level at 3 | disc 6); polarization-free form equivalent to the manuscript's polarized problem through the canonical principal polarization (relative Lemma P), ON THE SPOT, not proved in the tree; Buzzard locator UNVERIFIED
